chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Early records: Open the Door Richard, Joe Turner, Sarah Vaughan and Una Mae Carlisle
summary: He recorded Open the Door Richard with Dusty Fletcher, played the Baby Grand with Joe Turner, and recorded with Sarah Vaughan and Una Mae Carlisle.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: One of the things I wanted to get into, of course, was your recording history. And with both, I think, of your earliest recordings, I think, were both...actually featured vocalists, 'Open the Door Richard' and 'St. James Infirmary'.

Well 'Open the Door Richard' was a comedian, Dusty Fletcher, you see. And how that happened, Jack McVea had made a record on the coast and it was caught on fire and so we had to record this right quick. And that's how I did that with him. Then I did a week in the Baby Grand
with Joe Turner and then I made some recordings with Sarah Vaughan.
You did make some recordings with Sarah Vaughan?
Yeah. "I Got a Crush on You" and things like that. Yeah.

Yeah. I was on those. And Una Mae Carlisle, I made some recordings with her and him then Bobby Marshall I did some things with/on Decca, with Cozy's band, when I was with Cozy.* Oh, I forgot about Cozy. I was with Cozy too. And Joe Wilder was in the band, Cecil Payne and his brother, June Coles.
